Test two vctrs vectors for equality with some tolerance in some cases

Source: R/patch.R
vec_approx_equal.Rd

Generalizes vctrs::vec_equal.

Usage

vec_approx_equal(
  vec1,
  vec2,
  na_equal,
  .ptype = NULL,
  ...,
  abs_tol,
  inds1 = NULL,
  inds2 = NULL
)

Arguments

vec1, vec2

vctrs vectors (includes data frames). Take care when using on named vectors or "keyed" data frames; vec_names() are largely ignored, and key columns are treated as normal value columns (when they should probably generate an error if they are not lined up correctly, or be tested for exact rather than approximate equality).

na_equal

should NAs be considered equal to each other? (In epiprocess, we usually want this to be TRUE, but that doesn't match the vctrs::vec_equal() default, so this is mandatory.)

.ptype

as in vctrs::vec_equal().

...

should be empty (it's here to force later arguments to be passed by name)

abs_tol

absolute tolerance; will be used for bare numeric vec1, vec2, or any such columns within vec1, vec2 if they are data frames.

inds1, inds2

optional (row) indices into vec1 and vec2 compatible with vctrs::vec_slice(); output should be consistent with vec_slice-ing to these indices beforehand, but can give faster computation if vec1 and vec2 are data frames. Currently, any speedup is only by making sure that vec_slice is used rather than [ for data frames.

Value

logical vector, with length matching the result of recycling vec1 (at inds1 if provided) and vec2 (at inds2 if provided); entries should all be TRUE or FALSE if na_equal = TRUE.

Examples


library(dplyr)

# On numeric vectors:
vec_approx_equal(
  c(1, 2, 3, NA),
  c(1, 2 + 1e-10, NA, NA),
  na_equal = TRUE,
  abs_tol = 1e-8
)
#> [1]  TRUE  TRUE FALSE  TRUE

# On tibbles:
tbl1 <- tibble(
  a = 1:5,
  b = list(1:5, 1:4, 1:3, 1:2, 1:1) %>% lapply(as.numeric),
  c = tibble(
    c1 = 1:5
  ),
  d = matrix(1:10, 5, 2)
)
tbl2 <- tbl1
tbl2$a[[2]] <- tbl1$a[[2]] + 1e-10
tbl2$b[[3]][[1]] <- tbl1$b[[3]][[1]] + 1e-10
tbl2$c$c1[[4]] <- tbl1$c$c1[[4]] + 1e-10
tbl2$d[[5, 2]] <- tbl1$d[[5, 2]] + 1e-10
vctrs::vec_equal(tbl1, tbl2, na_equal = TRUE)
#> [1]  TRUE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE
vec_approx_equal(tbl1, tbl2, na_equal = TRUE, abs_tol = 1e-12)
#> [1]  TRUE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE
vec_approx_equal(tbl1, tbl2, na_equal = TRUE, abs_tol = 1e-8)
#> [1] TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE


# Type comparison within lists is stricter, matching vctrs:
vctrs::vec_equal(list(1:2), list(as.numeric(1:2)))
#> [1] FALSE
vec_approx_equal(list(1:2), list(as.numeric(1:2)), FALSE, abs_tol = 0)
#> [1] FALSE
